surface.output: One two-paragraph body. The first two complete sentences become the collapsed-card preview.
surface.person: we, someone, a named group, or the actual subject; never generic people or second person
hardRules: Begin with recognizable behavior, a decision, or a consequence.
Make the first two sentences complete, strong, and immediately clear because the card truncates after them.
Build one advancing lived sequence rather than an inventory of examples.
Mention the exact event naturally by the third sentence at the latest.
Use normal English. Do not make an abstract noun perform a human action.
Do not use em dashes, cryptic slogans, advocacy-default subject matter, corporate language, or a second conclusion.
End with the clearest behavioral truth, then stop.

event.title: Mercury stations retrograde in Pisces
event.fact: Mercury's apparent motion reaches zero before reversing; conventionally read a day or two either side.
event.scenes: replies delayed well past normal; travel plans changed twice in a day; the same conversation repeated in one meeting; a booking abandoned midway.
event.meaning: traditionally an unfavorable window for finalizing agreements, travel, and communication decisions. A pause reading, not a failure reading. Some decisions made at stations stand.

verifiedAstrology.planetFunction: Mercury describes the mind in motion: thought, language, questions, interpretation, learning, writing, conversation, and the way information becomes useful. It shows how someone notices patterns, names what is happening, and makes decisions from what they observe.

combinedMeaning.tldr: Mercury in Pisces: the mind is intuitive, poetic, and porous to subtle information.
combinedMeaning.body: With Mercury in Pisces, communication moves through images, feeling, dreams, and impression. Mercury is in detriment and fall here, so clarity needs extra structure.
combinedMeaning.gift: Imagination, empathy, symbolic thinking, and intuitive listening.
combinedMeaning.challenge: Confusion, avoidance, mixed signals, or letting emotion blur the facts.

verifiedAstrology.retrogradeMeaning: review of thinking, plans, and messages; recheck details and communications
boundary: Write collective Current Sky copy, never natal or transit-to-natal advice.
The ephemeris supplies dates, degrees, duration, direction, and exact event times. Do not write them.
Do not turn a review period into a prediction that every plan, purchase, promise, or relationship will fail.
Use the sign to describe style and subject only. Do not infer a house or unsupported life domain.
Chiron is an optional modern body, not a planet or a traditional timing factor.

task: Write one Current Sky timing-event card for Mercury stations retrograde in Pisces. Return only the complete body.

ownerPassages.text: If job loss or work instability is part of what's happening, the anxiety about money makes rest almost impossible. This Full Moon illuminates the cost of running on stress hormones and calling it productivity.
Set a two-line agenda before a meeting. Then create one honest boundary that protects recovery time. Block a half hour for a walk. Say no to a request that costs more than it gives.

Collectively, we begin to learn the cost of comfort, the limits of growth, and that real care needs a structure, a schedule and not just sentiment. There may not be a resolution this month, but there will be motion.
Now, we are in another period of upheaval. The old ways of earning, spending, and saving are becoming obsolete. Cryptocurrency challenges traditional banking.
Financial matters from the past reappear, debts call for repayment, and investments demand reassessment. But beneath the surface, this retrograde is about far more than money, it’s about worth.

Media literacy isn't enough anymore when the boundary between authentic and artificial keeps shifting. Social networks that promised connection deliver isolation. Search engines that promised knowledge deliver manipulation.
